prompt:
Image 1 is a pixel-art sprite sheet of a small empty-handed chibi knight for a top-down 2D game, seen from the front, the side and the back. Create ONE NEW sheet of a one-handed slash motion for this same knight. Keep exactly the same character, armour, helmet, size, proportions, palette, dark outline and pixel-art style as Image 1.

The knight carries nothing. Both hands are empty closed brown leather gloves. A sword will be added later, so the hands must be clearly visible and must not overlap the helmet.

Layout: exactly 3 rows and 3 columns on a completely flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Every character is the same size as in Image 1 and centred in an evenly spaced grid cell, all on the same baseline per row, with clear magenta space around them.

Row 1: facing the viewer, front view.
Row 2: facing right, side view.
Row 3: facing away from the viewer, back view.

Column 1, wind-up: the right arm is pulled back and raised to the side of the head, the body twists away, the feet are planted apart.
Column 2, strike: the right arm is thrown forward at full reach in the direction the knight faces, the body leans into the blow, the front foot steps forward.
Column 3, follow-through: the right arm has swept across to the other side of the body and is low, the body has turned with the swing.

The left arm stays low and close to the body in all columns.

Do not include: swords, weapons, shields, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, motion lines, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
